description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of notes merging, conflict resolution, and related operations in a Git-like version control system. It sets up various scenarios involving commits and notes, performs merge operations of notes refs, verifies the consistency of notes, and tests conflict resolution workflows.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution and output matching assertions.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if a pattern exists in the output.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Ensures a file or output is empty.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the test environment.

methods.name: test_oid
methods.description: Retrieves object IDs for specific hashes.

methods.name: verify_notes
methods.description: Verifies the notes in a given notes ref against expected outputs.

methods.name: notes_merge_files_gone
methods.description: Checks that merge state files are cleaned up after merge completion.
